text_block_list.text:
With the race over, Tokyo Racecourse was 
enveloped in excitement and fervor.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, Bourbon! That was a great 
run!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
But next is the Kikuka Sho, right? I just 
hope I can finish all 3,000 meters...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, since she didn't 
achieve the Triple Crown, she might not 
even run...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, our Bourbon will pull it off 
through sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Report. Result: 1st place. Mission 
complete, Master.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a bad run, but still... the 
dream of winning the Classic Triple Crown 
has been shattered...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is next, right? I hope I 
can make it through all 3,000 meters, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, since she didn't 
achieve the Triple Crown, she might not 
even run...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, our Bourbon will pull it off 
through sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Report. Result: Placed in the money. My 
apologies, Master.
—And Mihono Bourbon suddenly fell silent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Anomalous phenomenon confirmed. The 
Triple Crown objective has currently 
failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you continue in the Twinkle 
Series, achieving the Classic Triple Crown 
is out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... right now, there is a 
contradiction within me.

Struggling to explain it clearly, she 
slowly chooses her words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't achieve the Triple 
Crown... I still want to run in the Kikuka 
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
3,000m... A distance not yet reached, I 
want to run it all the way in a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have such a "desire." ...What do you 
think, Master?

Moved by her passionate words, I nod 
without a second thought.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order received, Master...!

I renewed my resolve for the Kikuka-sho. 
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Extreme exhaustion confirmed due to loss 
of focus and unsteady footing. Are you 
'all right'?

Whether she heard Mihono Bourbon's voice 
or not, she mutters under her breath as if 
delirious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice—Rice still... hasn't 'caught up' 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Haven't caught up"...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon is... incredible... That's 
why I have to try harder... and harder...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
More... more... more... Rice has to... 
change...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! Rice-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*...

After that, I carried Rice Shower and made 
sure she woke up before leaving Tokyo 
Racecourse behind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. Rice-san is incomprehensible to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why is she so "fixated" on me? And why 
does she say she'll "catch up"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The only outcomes of a race are 'victory' 
or 'defeat.' Yet Rice-san received 
neither—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I describe it as "catching up." I am 
running in order to "catch up."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if her definition of 'catching 
up' differs from the ordinary one—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I fail to comprehend the intention behind 
this, or what goal they hope to achieve by 
entering this race."

Everyone carries their own feelings into a 
race. For some Umamusume, the results 
aren't what matters most.

Intuition is something you can only truly 
understand once you've experienced it 
yourself.

"Mihono Bourbon already struggles to grasp 
emotions as it is, so this might still be 
a bit difficult for her."
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the day will come when you 
understand both.

text_block_list.text:
I'll likely continue clashing with Rice 
Shower in the Twinkle Series from now on.

Let's not rush, and wait for the day we 
understand the true meaning behind it. 
When I said that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The basis is unclear, but since it is 
Master's opinion, I deem it worthy of 
implementation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will wait for the "day I'll understand."

The train quietly headed toward the 
Academy.

Next is the final race of the Classic 
Triple Crown. The Kikuka Sho...!
